description: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Coverage: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Barrages hydroélectriques de type linéaire en Auvergne Rhône-Alpes; Inventaire des ouvrages hydrauliques (Digues) en 2015 sur le Rhône et ; Systèmes d'endiguement classés au titre de la sécurité des ouvrages en; Inventaire des ouvrages hydrauliques (Barrages) en 2015 sur le Rhône e. Formats seen: ZIP, MAPINFO TAB, WFS, WMS, UTF8. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
